claim_summary: ReasonCast contributes a routed semantic intervention for demand forecasting: an LLM reasoner emits structured event fields, a three-action routing policy trained on forecast utility decides whether to intervene, and the fields are fused into a frozen Chronos-2 forecaster with gated additive and multiplicative corrections.

claim_evidence.quote: We formulate event-enhanced demand forecasting as selective semantic intervention, shifting the focus from extracting more text to controlling its marginal influence on a strong numerical forecaster.

modules.name: Structured event-semantics reasoner (schema SFT and semantic-field RL)
modules.scope_reason: R2 LLM: schema SFT and semantic-field RL train the reasoner that emits structured event fields. Forecast-utility RL is assigned to the routing policy module, not here.

evidence.quote: Reasoner supervision. We stratify 40,000 item–window candidates by trajectory regime and obtain 11,627 teacher generations.
parseable and internally consistent outputs, and semantic-field RL improves forecast-critical judgments such as direction, amplitude, and peak intensity.

modules.name: Forecast-utility trained routing policy (Skip, Basic, Tool)
modules.scope_reason: R2 LLM: the routing policy is trained with forecast-utility RL against a frozen forecaster and selects the action from forecast context. The fixed pipeline around it is not a separate harness module.

evidence.quote: Given event context, the no-text forecast, and its entropy, the agent selects Skip, low-cost Basic semantics, or tool-augmented Tool
Forecast-utility RL trains the agent policy—including route selection, tool use, and the final intervention decision—against realized downstream utility from the frozen forecaster

modules.name: Event-selective dual-path fusion into the Chronos-2 forecaster
modules.scope_reason: R2 LLM: trainable text encoder, aligner and fusion layers decide how event tokens enter the forecaster representation; the Chronos-2 backbone stays frozen. Counterfactual TSK reading is noted for human review.

evidence.quote: The interface is applied to the Chronos-2 future-token representation before the prediction head. Thus, only the event component queries text
changes but may have limited authority over large level shifts. We therefore introduce a complementary multiplicative correction:
The property is enforced by the routing action and an explicit mask rather than learned approximately.

process_validity.quote: SFT establishes parseability and improves direction and shape;

temporal_validity.quote: To prevent temporal leakage, all textual descriptions and event information are restricted to records available before the corresponding forecast origin.

task_performance.quote: ReasonCast obtains the lowest WMAPE on all six proprietary event slices and on M5 event windows

changes: name: schema and semantic-field reasoner training
forecast-utility RL scope moved to the routing policy module
reconciliation.reason: Packet shows schema SFT and semantic-field RL train the reasoner; the packet states forecast-utility RL trains the agent policy (route selection, tool use, intervention), so that part is a separate LLM module. Layer LLM and role model_training are unchanged.

changes: dimensions: Tools and Execution, Planning and Workflow -> none (LLM module)
new module reasoncast2026:skip-basic-tool-routing for the routing policy
reconciliation.reason: The card merges two mechanisms. The Skip/Basic/Tool routing policy is a trained LLM-side policy (workflow_learning). The gated additive and multiplicative fusion into the forecaster is a representation alignment mechanism that keeps the id. Planning and Workflow is a retired seven-dimension label and is removed because LLM modules carry no dimensions. The TSK assignment fails R3 as an LLM module, and the card's dimensions are not applicable.

notes: Ambiguities for the adjudicator: (1) the fusion module could be read as TSK, since it is forecast-specific; it is classified LLM representation_alignment under R2 because the text encoder, aligner and fusion layers are trained and the Chronos-2 backbone is frozen; (2) the routing policy is read as LLM workflow_learning, not Harness, because its decisions are trained; (3) the tool route (event retrieval and temporal statistics) is not a separate module, since the packet gives it no separate mechanism; (4) the card's evidence_locators are page references and are replaced by line-level quotes; (5) process_validity is marked on parseability of structured outputs (medium reading).
